research_scope: New controllable video and animation capability demos; verified primary sources, not an unverified daily popularity ranking.

rounds.title_zh: 脚掌落地不打滑：支撑相接触锁定与步态逆运动学选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Grounded steps without foot skating: stance-contact locking and gait IK FAQ
conclusions_zh: 滑步源于在根骨骼局部空间摆腿而髋部在世界空间匀速推进，两者速度在支撑相无法抵消。
支撑相把脚踝锁死在世界地面锚点并反求 1.45/1.35 双连杆 IK，81 个采样帧保持零滑移（1.78e-15 u 对比未锁基线 0.2452 u）。
65 实体双足桁架核验确定性接触约束与 Node CPU 求解，不冒充 StepControl 或 ARDY 神经扩散推理。
conclusions_en: Foot skating occurs when legs swing in hip-local space while the hip translates uniformly in world space.
Pinning stance ankles to world ground anchors and solving 1.45/1.35 two-link IK retains zero slip across 81 frames (1.78e-15 u vs 0.2452 u unpinned).
The 65-solid bipedal rig verifies deterministic contact locking and Node CPU solving without claiming StepControl or ARDY diffusion execution.

rounds.title_zh: 高速旋转不飞出切线：亚帧快门圆弧积分与线性速度涂抹选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Curved motion without tangent spikes: sub-frame shutter integration vs linear velocity blur FAQ
conclusions_zh: 单帧瞬时速度向量只记录切线方向，270° 快门下线性涂抹向叶轮外缘飞出 0.0854 示意单位。
快门窗内 9 个亚帧时刻沿圆弧采样严格守恒半径 R=2.2（61 帧最大径向误差 8.88e-16 u）。
64 实体斩波轮对比递推相量与逐抽头三角函数（24.28 ms vs 42.74 ms），不冒充 MoBGS 或 SplineGS 神经去模糊。
conclusions_en: Instantaneous velocity vectors capture only the tangent direction, overshooting the rotor rim by 0.0854 units at 270° shutter.
Sampling 9 sub-frame taps along the curved trajectory preserves exact R=2.2 across 61 frames (max error 8.88e-16 u).
The 64-solid chopper compares incremental phasor stepping against per-tap trig (24.28 ms vs 42.74 ms) without claiming MoBGS or SplineGS inference.

rounds.title_zh: 多机位切镜不跳轴：180 度动作轴线与屏幕左右方向守恒选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Multi-camera cuts without direction flips: 180-degree line-of-action and screen-order continuity FAQ
conclusions_zh: 切镜跳轴源于机位跨过双主体有向动作轴所在的二维半平面，导致投影左右顺序反转。
同侧半平面门禁在 4 镜头 121 个采样帧实现 0 次屏幕左右反转，越轴基线在第 3 镜产生 30 帧反转。
59 实体四机位舞台对比解析相机正交基投影与 4x4 矩阵求逆（2.29 ms vs 4.18 ms），不冒充 SynCamMaster 多视角生成。
conclusions_en: Crossing the 180-degree line of action moves the camera into the opposite 2D half-plane, reversing projected left-to-right screen order.
The same-side half-plane gate retains 0 screen-order flips across 121 frames and 4 cuts, whereas the axis-crossed Shot 3 flips 30 frames.
The 59-solid stage compares orthonormal camera-basis projection against 4x4 matrix inversion (2.29 ms vs 4.18 ms) without claiming SynCamMaster execution.

rounds.title_zh: 图形变形不自交不扭麻花：地标锚定弧长对应与原始顶点插值选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Shape morphing without self-crossing twists: landmark-anchored arc-length correspondence vs vertex-index interpolation FAQ
conclusions_zh: 闭合轮廓按原始顶点下标直接插值会因起始点（Vertex 0）接缝错位而横穿中心扭成自交麻花。
对齐最优循环移位 Δ*=11 后传输弦长平方和从 388.23 降至 6.20 u²，101 个变形步全程 0 处边自交（原始下标中点 12 处自交）。
61 实体机械缩放仪对比基波相位对齐与全移位扫描（8192 次 51.21 ms vs 130.65 ms），不冒充 OmniLottie 神经矢量生成。
conclusions_en: Interpolating closed contours by raw vertex index twists across the interior whenever their starting seams disagree.
Aligning cyclic shift Δ*=11 lowers chord transport cost from 388.23 to 6.20 u² and retains 0 self-intersections across 101 steps (vs 12 midpoint crossings).
The 61-solid pantograph compares harmonic phase alignment against exhaustive shift scanning (51.21 ms vs 130.65 ms at 8192 morphs) without claiming OmniLottie execution.

rounds.title_zh: 掉帧卡顿也不炸飞：时间步长无关解析弹簧跟随与显式欧拉积分选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Secondary follow-through that survives frame drops: closed-form analytical spring damper vs explicit Euler integration FAQ
conclusions_zh: 显式前向欧拉积分在 80ms 浏览器掉帧下（ω₀·Δt=1.44）突破单调界限，在 t=0.16s 产生 4.2944 示意单位过冲。
闭式矩阵指数满足半群性质 exp(A·Δt₁)exp(A·Δt₂)=exp(A·(Δt₁+Δt₂))，101 采样帧保持 0 过冲与 4.44e-16 u 步长漂移。
65 实体双轨滑台对比闭式指数与 96 子步 RK4（1.18 ms vs 22.28 ms），不冒充 Spring-Gaus 神经三维高斯重建。
conclusions_en: Explicit forward Euler violates monotonic bounds under 80ms frame drops (ω₀·Δt=1.44), overshooting the target by 4.2944 units at t=0.16s.
Closed-form matrix exponentials satisfy the semigroup property, retaining 0 overshoot and 4.44e-16 u drift across 101 frames.
The 65-solid twin-track rig compares closed-form exponential updates against 96-substep RK4 (1.18 ms vs 22.28 ms) without claiming Spring-Gaus execution.

rounds.title_zh: 弯道运镜不忽快忽慢：弧长重参数化匀速样条轨道与原始参数 t 插值选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Smooth camera rails without speed surges: arc-length reparameterized cubic splines vs raw parameter-t interpolation FAQ
conclusions_zh: 三次贝塞尔曲线参数 u 不是弧长，直接令 u=t/T 会在控制点密集的弯道滞后 1.392 u 并在直道暴冲 +96.63%。
128 段高斯-勒让德累积弧长表加 2 步牛顿迭代在 81 个采样帧保持恒定 0.942 u/s 世界速度（弧长误差 3.55e-15 u）。
63 实体双滑车导轨对比查表牛顿法与 32 步积分二分（4.66 ms vs 631.88 ms），不冒充 TrajectoryCrafter 神经视频重定向。
conclusions_en: Polynomial Bezier parameter u is not arc length; u=t/T lags by 1.392 units in tight bends and surges +96.63% on wide spans.
A 128-entry Gauss-Legendre LUT with 2 Newton steps locks world speed at 0.942 u/s across 81 frames (3.55e-15 u arc error).
The 63-solid twin-dolly rail compares LUT+Newton against 32-step quadrature bisection (4.66 ms vs 631.88 ms) without claiming TrajectoryCrafter execution.

rounds.title_zh: 朝向插值不原地甩头 340 度：四元数双覆盖半球对齐与未对齐 SLERP 选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Rotation blending without 340-degree spin spikes: quaternion double-cover hemisphere alignment vs unaligned SLERP FAQ
conclusions_zh: 单位四元数 q 与 -q 对应完全相同的三维旋转矩阵 R(q)=R(-q)，但跨 ±180° 偏航时原始内积 q_A·q_B=-0.9848<0 会触发 340.0° 远路甩头。
插值前翻转负内积四元数至同号半球可将旋转路径锁定在 20.0° 最短测地弧，消除 α=0.5 处的 144.0° 镜筒反向错误。
51 实体双联转塔对比闭式三角 SLERP 与 32 步李群测地递推（2.80 ms vs 22.99 ms），不冒充 SplineGS 动态三维高斯重建。
conclusions_en: Unit quaternions q and -q represent the identical 3D rotation matrix R(q)=R(-q), yet raw dot product -0.9848<0 across ±180° yaw triggers a 340.0° spin.
Negating the target quaternion into the same S³ hemisphere locks the 20.0° shortest geodesic arc and eliminates the 144.0° midpoint reversal.
The 51-solid twin turret compares closed-form trig SLERP against 32-step geodesic stepping (2.80 ms vs 22.99 ms) without claiming SplineGS execution.

rounds.title_zh: 切换旋转中心不瞬移：支点补偿变换矩阵与直接改 Pivot 选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Changing rotation pivots without position pops: world-invariant pivot compensation vs naive origin shift FAQ
conclusions_zh: 三明治旋转矩阵 T(t)T(p)R(θ)T(-p) 将局部支点与旋转角耦合进平移项，θ₀=36° 时直接改支点会产生 1.6069 u 瞬间跳变。
切换支点时原子写入平移补偿 t₂ = t₁ + (R(θ₀)-I)(p₂-p₁) 可将交接瞬间跳变降至 2.87e-15 u。
58 实体双锁扣横梁对比直接仿射补偿与 4 矩阵齐次连乘（8192 次 0.96 ms vs 7.80 ms），不冒充 Dream2Flow 神经物体流。
conclusions_en: Sandwich rotation T(t)T(p)R(θ)T(-p) couples local pivot and rotation into translation, causing a 1.6069 u teleport when shifting pivots at θ₀=36°.
Committing translation compensation t₂ = t₁ + (R(θ₀)-I)(p₂-p₁) reduces handoff discontinuity to 2.87e-15 u.
The 58-solid walking-beam rig compares direct affine compensation against 4-matrix chain multiplication (0.96 ms vs 7.80 ms at 8192 transforms) without claiming Dream2Flow execution.

rounds.title_zh: 推拉变焦主体大小不漂移：视锥截面宽度守恒与线性焦距插值选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Hitchcock dolly-zoom without subject drift: frustum half-width invariant vs linear FOV interpolation FAQ
conclusions_zh: 对相机物距 d 与视场角 θ 分别做独立线性插值会因正切非线性导致中点 α=0.5 视锥膨胀，使前景主体缩水 22.21%。
锁死视锥半高不变量 W* = d₀·tan(θ₀/2) = 1.9996 u 在全部 101 步保持前景 40.01% 屏幕占比零漂移，同时背景放大 1.73 倍。
57 实体光学走廊对比直接余切比例与 32 步二分反解（0.49 ms vs 9.08 ms），不冒充 Generative Photography 神经扩散生成。
conclusions_en: Interpolating camera distance d and FOV θ linearly and independently swells the midpoint frustum, shrinking the foreground subject by 22.21%.
Locking the frustum half-height invariant W* = d₀·tan(θ₀/2) = 1.9996 u retains 40.01% subject screen height with 0% drift while expanding the background 1.73x.
The 57-solid corridor compares direct cotangent scaling against 32-step FOV bisection (0.49 ms vs 9.08 ms) without claiming Generative Photography execution.

rounds.title_zh: 高速过弯不僵硬平漂：路径曲率向心倾角与纯切向朝向选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: High-speed turns without flat skidding: curvature-coupled centripetal banking vs tangent-only orientation FAQ
conclusions_zh: 固定 world-up 的 lookAt 在八字航线弯心 t=1.12s 强制横滚为 0°，产生 0.7193 g 未补偿横向平漂甩力。
由轨迹一二阶导数叉积直接导出协调压坡角 φ* = atan(v²κ/g) = -35.73°，81 个采样帧保持侧滑过载 1.81e-16 g。
63 实体双机测试台对比解析导数曲率与 5 点中心差分模板（1.34 ms vs 2.10 ms），不冒充 NMPC 飞控或气动 CFD。
conclusions_en: Fixed world-up lookAt locks roll at 0° through corners, causing 0.7193 g of uncompensated lateral skid at apex t=1.12s.
Deriving coordinated roll φ* = atan(v²κ/g) = -35.73° from 1st and 2nd path derivatives cancels cabin lateral slip to 1.81e-16 g across 81 frames.
The 63-solid twin-flyer testbed compares analytical derivative curvature against a 5-point stencil (1.34 ms vs 2.10 ms) without claiming NMPC or CFD execution.

rounds.title_zh: 循环动画接缝不跳帧：整倍谐波频率量化与无理数频谱突变选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Seamless looping waves without seam pops: integer-harmonic frequency quantization vs unquantized spectrum drift FAQ
conclusions_zh: 在有限循环周期 T=6.0s 内叠加非整数倍频率会在 t=T→0 回环瞬间造成 1.8875 u 位置跳变与 4.5270 u/s 速度跳变。
将各分量角频率量化为基频整数倍 ω_m = 2π·n_m/T (n=1,2,4,5) 可同时实现位置（1.39e-15 u）与速度（5.33e-15 u/s）的 C∞ 周期闭合。
56 实体 16 肋振荡器对比时空分离三角基与逐肋条 Math.sin 调用（19.16 ms vs 68.78 ms），不冒充 Loopy 或 Mobius 视频扩散。
conclusions_en: Layering non-integer frequencies over period T=6.0s causes a 1.8875 u position pop and 4.5270 u/s velocity jump when wrapping t=T→0.
Quantizing angular frequencies to integer multiples ω_m = 2π·n_m/T (n=1,2,4,5) closes both position (1.39e-15 u) and velocity (5.33e-15 u/s) seams.
The 56-solid 16-rib oscillator compares a factored spatial-temporal trig basis against per-rib Math.sin calls (19.16 ms vs 68.78 ms) without claiming Loopy or Mobius execution.

rounds.title_zh: 边缘大物体不闪烁消失：保守包围球视锥裁剪与中心点裁剪选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Frustum culling without edge popping: radius-padded bounding-sphere tests vs center-point culling FAQ
conclusions_zh: 只检验中心点 n·c+d ≥ 0 会将中心刚移出视锥边界但球面仍在画面内的 4 颗跨界球体提前误删。
使用单位向内平面法向并外扩半径阈值 n·c+d ≥ -r 可在全部 71 个摇摄角实现 0 次边缘误裁闪烁（14° 下完整保留 11/11 颗可见球体）。
54 实体 18 球视锥雷达对比相机空间单位平面点乘与 Gribb-Hartmann 矩阵归一化（5.71 ms vs 12.82 ms），不冒充 StopThePop 或 FlashGS CUDA 光栅化。
conclusions_en: Center-point culling (n·c+d ≥ 0) prematurely drops 4 visible boundary-straddling spheres at 14° pan when their centers cross the plane.
Padding unit-normal frustum planes by radius r (n·c+d ≥ -r) retains all 11/11 visible spheres and achieves 0 false pops across 71 pan angles.
The 54-solid radar stage compares camera-space unit planes against Gribb-Hartmann matrix normalization (5.71 ms vs 12.82 ms) without claiming StopThePop or FlashGS execution.

rounds.title_zh: 交叉叠化与残影不发黑发脏：线性辐射度空间混合与 sRGB 编码值直混选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Cross-fades and trails without dark mud: linear-light radiance blending vs gamma-encoded sRGB mixing FAQ
conclusions_zh: 直接对伽马压缩的 sRGB 编码值求平均会在红青互补色中点（α=0.50）输出 #808080，经屏幕幂律展开后物理亮度跌至 Y=0.2140，吞噬 57.19% 光子能量（全梯度最大损耗 61.36%）。
先按 IEC 61966-2-1 EOTF 解码至线性辐射度空间相加再经 OETF 编码回 sRGB（#BCBCBC, 0.7354），可在全部 41 个检查点实现 100.00% 物理光子能量守恒（0.00% 发黑损耗）。
41 实体 17 阶辐射度光学台对比预解码线性端点+4096 项查找表与逐采样 Math.pow(2.4) 幂运算（0.884 ms vs 17.896 ms，提速 20.2×），不冒充 HDR-GS 或 GaussHDR 神经色调映射。
conclusions_en: Averaging gamma-compressed sRGB code values directly at the red-cyan midpoint (α=0.50) outputs #808080 (Y=0.2140), destroying 57.19% of physical photon energy (61.36% peak ramp loss).
Decoding via IEC 61966-2-1 EOTF to linear radiance before mixing and re-encoding to sRGB (#BCBCBC, 0.7354) preserves 100.00% physical photon luminance across all 41 checkpoints.
The 41-solid 17-swatch bench compares pre-decoded linear endpoints + a 4096-entry LUT against per-sample Math.pow(2.4) (0.884 ms vs 17.896 ms, 20.2× faster) without claiming HDR-GS execution.

rounds.title_zh: 多关节机械臂与触手不拉长不乱抖：FABRIK 双向定长追逐逆运动学与线性雅可比选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Multi-joint IK without bone stretching or singularity jitter: FABRIK forward-and-backward reaching vs linearized Jacobian step FAQ
conclusions_zh: 一阶线性切向步因正交切线分量满足勾股定理 L_i·sqrt(1+Δθ²)，在 28° 目标下造成单骨拉伸 0.5275 u、总臂长从 5.50 u 膨胀至 8.0553 u（+46.46%）。
采用可达半径钳制（R_max=5.50 u）与 FABRIK 双向球面投影迭代，可在全部 61 个目标角将 5 节骨长误差锁死在 4.44e-16 u 且根部零滑移。
48 实体 5 连杆机械臂台对比三维向量归一化投影与球坐标反三角函数（59.63 ms vs 126.13 ms，提速 2.11×），不冒充 RigAnything 或 MagicArticulate 神经绑定。
conclusions_en: Unprojected first-order tangent steps inflate bone lengths by L_i·sqrt(1+Δθ²), causing 0.5275 u max single-bone stretch and inflating total reach from 5.50 u to 8.0553 u (+46.46%) at 28°.
Combining reachability radial clamping (R_max=5.50 u) with FABRIK forward-and-backward sphere projections locks all 5 bone lengths within 4.44e-16 u across 61 target angles.
The 48-solid 5-link bench compares direct 3D vector projection against spherical trigonometry (59.63 ms vs 126.13 ms, 2.11× faster) without claiming RigAnything execution.

rounds.title_zh: 悬链与布料不无限拉长下垂：多子步 Gauss-Seidel 距离约束投影与单遍松弛选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Suspended cables and cloth without rubbery sag: multi-substep Gauss-Seidel distance constraints vs single-pass relaxation FAQ
conclusions_zh: 单遍并行 Jacobi 松弛每遍仅能将固定锚点张力向内传递 1 节连杆，在 2.6 重力载荷下导致跨中单节拉长 0.1459 u、总长从 9.60 u 膨胀至 10.1220 u。
采用逆质量锚定（w_0=w_12=0）与对称正逆向 Gauss-Seidel 原地距离投影，可在全部 35 个载荷下将单节误差锁在 0.0036 u 以内（总长 9.6089 u，双塔零滑移）。
48 实体 12 节双塔悬链台对比预分配 Float64Array 原地投影与逐遍对象克隆（1024 次求解 77.00 ms vs 89.32 ms，零 GC 分配），不冒充 Generalized PBD 或 GPU 有限元。
conclusions_en: Single-pass parallel Jacobi relaxation propagates boundary pin tension by only 1 link per pass, leaving midspan links stretched by 0.1459 u and inflating total length from 9.60 u to 10.1220 u.
Encoding fixed pins via inverse mass (w_0=w_12=0) and sweeping symmetric forward-and-backward Gauss-Seidel projections in place locks total cable length at 9.6089 u (max link error 0.0036 u).
The 48-solid 12-segment twin-tower stage compares in-place Float64Array projection against object-cloned sweeps (77.00 ms vs 89.32 ms at 1,024 solves) without claiming GPU FEM execution.

rounds.title_zh: 亚像素抗锯齿不聚团不漏格：Halton(2,3) 低差异序列抖动与伪随机采样选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Sub-pixel anti-aliasing without clumping voids: Halton(2,3) low-discrepancy jitter vs pseudo-random sampling FAQ
conclusions_zh: 伪随机采样受生日悖论聚团支配，16 个采样点在 4×4 亚像素网格中漏空 11 格（最大盲区半径 0.7755 px），在 +0.22 px 偏移处造成 0.1980 覆盖率误差。
采用互质基数 (2,3) 的 Halton 根逆反射序列可均匀命中 14/16 个亚像素子格（最大空白半径 0.2415 px），将斜线覆盖率误差降至 0.0105（精度提升 18.9×）。
54 实体 4×4 亚像素超采样台对比整数除模根逆循环与字符串进制反转（8192 次 1.65 ms vs 50.23 ms，提速 30.4×），不冒充 DLSS、FSR 或 Mip-Splatting CUDA 核。
conclusions_en: Pseudo-random sampling suffers Birthday-Paradox clumping, leaving 11/16 sub-cells empty (0.7755 px max void radius) and causing a 0.1980 ribbon coverage error at +0.22 px.
Halton(2,3) radical-inverse jitter occupies 14/16 sub-pixel strata (0.2415 px max void radius) and reduces ribbon coverage error by 18.9× to 0.0105.

The 54-solid 4×4 sub-pixel stage compares integer modulo/division radical inversion against string digit reversal (1.65 ms vs 50.23 ms at 8,192 passes, 30.4× faster) without claiming DLSS or Mip-Splatting execution.
